why: Normative advice ('you have to outthink the crowd because first level thinking is superficial'), not a physical cause->visible effect; no nameable object end.
'Chilling because it reveals a truth' is the narrator's evaluation of the Asch experiment, not a drawable relation; effect end is an adjective.
Hypothetical 'next time you feel the urge' framing; psychological urge has no honest visible effect and others-making-money is only a fragment.
'Mission feels subversive because it goes against human nature' is a framing remark; ends not nameable as entities and a contract would add nothing.
